entries.title: Romans 14:1
segments: ¶Receive one who is weak in the faith, [but] not to disputes over doubtful things.

entries.title: Romans 14:2
segments: For one believes he may eat all things, but he who is weak eats [only] vegetables.

entries.title: Romans 14:3
segments: Let not him who eats despise him who does not eat, and let not him who does not eat judge him who eats; for God has received him.

entries.title: Romans 14:4
segments: Who are you to judge another's servant? To his own master he stands or falls. Indeed, he will be made to stand, for God is able to make him stand.

entries.title: Romans 14:5
segments: One person esteems [one] day above another; another esteems every day [alike]. Let each be fully convinced in his own mind.

entries.title: Romans 14:6
segments: He who observes the day, observes [it] to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe [it]. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks; and he who does not eat, to the Lord he does not eat, and gives God thanks.

entries.title: Romans 14:7
segments: For none of us lives to himself, and no one dies to himself.

entries.title: Romans 14:8
segments: For if we live, we live to the Lord; and if we die, we die to the Lord. Therefore, whether we live or die, we are the Lord's.

entries.title: Romans 14:9
segments: For to this end Christ died and rose and lived again, that He might be Lord of both the dead and the living.

entries.title: Romans 14:10
segments: But why do you judge your brother? Or why do you show contempt for your brother? For we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

entries.title: Romans 14:11
segments: For it is written: "[As] I live, says the LORD, Every knee shall bow to Me, And every tongue shall confess to God."

entries.title: Romans 14:12
segments: So then each of us shall give account of himself to God.

entries.title: Romans 14:13
segments: Therefore let us not judge one another anymore, but rather resolve this, not to put a stumbling block or a cause to fall in [our] brother's way.

entries.title: Romans 14:14
segments: I know and am convinced by the Lord Jesus that [there is] nothing unclean of itself; but to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him [it is] unclean.

entries.title: Romans 14:15
segments: Yet if your brother is grieved because of [your] food, you are no longer walking in love. Do not destroy with your food the one for whom Christ died.

entries.title: Romans 14:16
segments: Therefore do not let your good be spoken of as evil;

entries.title: Romans 14:17
segments: for the kingdom of God is not eating and drinking, but righteousness and peace and joy in the Holy Spirit.

entries.title: Romans 14:18
segments: For he who serves Christ in these things [is] acceptable to God and approved by men.

entries.title: Romans 14:19
segments: Therefore let us pursue the things [which make] for peace and the things by which one may edify another.

entries.title: Romans 14:20
segments: Do not destroy the work of God for the sake of food. All things indeed [are] pure, but [it is] evil for the man who eats with offense.

entries.title: Romans 14:21
segments: [It is] good neither to eat meat nor drink wine nor [do anything] by which your brother stumbles or is offended or is made weak.

entries.title: Romans 14:22
segments: Do you have faith? Have [it] to yourself before God. Happy [is] he who does not condemn himself in what he approves.

entries.title: Romans 14:23
segments: But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because [he does] not [eat] from faith; for whatever [is] not from faith is sin.
